overview:
Monasteries, a summit camp and the paragliding capital in one long weekend: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to McLeodganj.

Day 1 covers the McLeodganj flea market, Bhagsu Waterfall, the Dalai Lama Monastery and the cafes. Day 2 is the Triund trek (9,350 ft), with the Dhauladhar range on one side and Kangra Valley on the other, and a night in camps. Day 3 treks down and drives to Bir via the HPCA Stadium, Palampur tea gardens and Baijnath Temple, ending with a bonfire at a homestay. Day 4 is for Bir Billing, where you can fly from Billing to Bir (15 to 30 minutes, own cost), before the evening departure. Prices start at ₹8,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to McLeodganj in an AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: McLeodganj exploration | Dalai Lama Monastery
itinerary.content:
Reach McLeodganj, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
After some rest, explore the McLeodganj flea market.
Visit Bhagsu Waterfall, the Dalai Lama Monastery and the cafes.
Back to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Triund trek | Camping
itinerary.content:
Freshen up and have breakfast.
Trek to Triund, the crown jewel of Dharamshala, with the Dhauladhar range on one side and Kangra Valley on the other.
Reach Triund in the evening and check in to the camps.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Triund to Bir
itinerary.content:
Have breakfast, trek down and collect your luggage from the hotel.
Drive to Bir via Dharamshala's HPCA Stadium, the Palampur tea gardens and Baijnath Temple.
Check in at a homestay in Bir.
Bonfire with light music, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bir Billing paragliding | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and have breakfast.
Head to the Billing paragliding take-off site and fly from Billing to Bir, a 15 to 30 minute ride (paragliding at own cost).
Enjoy Bir's views and cafes.
Evening departure for the overnight journey home.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to McLeodganj. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the McLeodganj, Triund & Bir trip cost?

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
